hooks.command: input=$(cat); case "$input" in *git*commit*|*git*merge*) if command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$input" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/AgentTaskComplete.ps1" -Hook; else printf '%s' "$input" | powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/AgentTaskComplete.ps1" -Hook; fi ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac
hooks.statusMessage: Checking that this state was validated
